framing: CLEAN-SLATE REWRITE: the entire old backend (Flask 3.1.3, 41 HTML routes) is DELETED. The comparison is for a BRAND-NEW on-device JSON API serving the locked Flutter frontend. Migration cost from old routes is irrelevant. Developer asks: final recommendation on the FastAPI path AND the Flask path, with advantages, disadvantages, community plugins, download/scraping tooling.
hard_constraint: The new backend runs ON-DEVICE in the Android APK via Chaquopy (Python 3.13). Verified live facts: pydantic-core 2.50.5 (FastAPI's validation core, Rust) ships 0 Android wheels out of 140 files on PyPI, and chaquo.com returns 404 for it (chaquopy#1017 open). MarkupSafe (Flask's native dep) ships 6 Android wheels including cp313 arm64+x86_64. Pure-Python packages install freely.

advantages: Best API-contract ergonomics: Pydantic models ARE the Flutter contract; OpenAPI/Swagger docs generate themselves (checklist item 4 solves itself)
Async-first; native background tasks; dependency injection; WebSocket if ever needed
Largest modern community; AI-tooling friendly; 100% typed + tested
disadvantages: BLOCKED ON-DEVICE today: pydantic-core has no Android wheel (verified live 0/140 on PyPI; chaquo.com 404; chaquopy#1017 open, PR #1413 unmerged)
Workaround = self-build + maintain Android wheels for pydantic-core (Rust cross-compile) on EVERY upstream release - an ongoing burden with no upstream support
uvicorn in secondary Android threads: signal-handler crashes without patching; pure-Python mode works but is slower
Async complexity buys nothing for a single-user offline sync app
fastapi_path.ecosystem: fastapi-users, pydantic-settings, slowapi (rate limit), apscheduler integration, SQLModel - all server-oriented; on-device the plugin story thins
fastapi_path.verdict: Superior contract ergonomics, blocked by a hard install fact. Only viable if the team commits to maintaining custom Android wheels for pydantic-core, or if serving mode B removes the embedded constraint (it does not - pydantic-core still must install in the APK).

advantages: PROVEN on-device: Flask 3.1.3 + Werkzeug + MarkupSafe 3.0.4 ship Android cp313 wheels (6 files verified live on PyPI); the current APK already runs this exact stack
From-scratch Flask is NOT the old Flask: fresh JSON-first Blueprints, no HTML routes, no legacy patterns - the rewrite deletes them anyway
Pure-Python dependency chain installs cleanly via Chaquopy (pure-Python sdists supported since 17.0)
Sync + sqlite3 = natural fit for single-user offline (no async complexity)
disadvantages: No automatic validation/OpenAPI - the API contract (checklist item 4) needs a layer
Werkzeug server is single-user grade (fine here); Waitress optional
Sync: background work stays with the custom scheduler (already built)

ecosystem_close_the_gap.point: The contract ergonomics gap closes with pure-Python Flask extensions

options.name: Apiflask
options.gives: OpenAPI 3.1 + schema validation + auto docs on Flask; marshmallow-based (pure Python)

options.name: flask-smorest
options.gives: OpenAPI 3 + marshmallow validation + error handling; Blueprint-first (matches our Blueprint structure)

options.name: stdlib dataclasses + fixture tests
options.gives: zero-dependency contract via dataclasses + the existing 717-test pattern

ecosystem_close_the_gap.verdict: Apiflask or flask-smorest delivers FastAPI-style contract + docs with PURE-PYTHON wheels that install on-device

flask_path.verdict: The pragmatic winner for an on-device rewrite: full contract ergonomics via pure-Python extensions, zero wheel risk

download_scraping_tooling.name: httpx
download_scraping_tooling.role: primary HTTP client for the 12 channels (sync, HTTP/2, timeouts)

download_scraping_tooling.name: curl_cffi
download_scraping_tooling.role: ONLY if a channel ever needs browser TLS impersonation (held per D4 - not currently needed)

download_scraping_tooling.name: openpyxl or python-calamine
download_scraping_tooling.weight: calamine = Rust (wheel risk on-device); openpyxl = pure Python, slower but safe

download_scraping_tooling.name: csv/json/zip stdlib
download_scraping_tooling.role: NSDL CSV, BSE JSON, NSE WDM CSV - stdlib suffices

download_scraping_tooling.name: selectolax/BeautifulSoup
download_scraping_tooling.role: only if HTML channels appear (none in the current 12-channel plan)

on_both: DECISION: Flask-from-scratch, JSON-first Blueprints + Apiflask (or flask-smorest) for the contract layer. FastAPI is ruled out ON-DEVICE by the pydantic-core wheel fact - regardless of clean-slate freedom.
The locked JSON contract (routes + shapes) is IDENTICAL under both paths - only the transport/validation library changes. The contract is not at risk from this choice.
Revisit FastAPI only if (a) pydantic-core ships Android wheels upstream (chaquopy#1017), or (b) serving mode B removes the embedded constraint AND the team accepts custom-wheel maintenance.
final_recommendation.fastapi_path_summary: World-class contract ergonomics, blocked on-device by a missing wheel; viable only with self-maintained Android wheels.
final_recommendation.flask_path_summary: Proven on-device, pure-Python contract layer via Apiflask/flask-smorest, bounded rewrite, smallest APK.
